title: Canonical integral section-action coefficient transport
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite with its valuation ring and uniformizer [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and $X$ any scheme on its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Put $B=p_X^*\underline{\mathcal O_E}$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients] and $\widehat B=\varprojlim_{n\ge1}(\mathcal O_E/\pi_E^n)_X$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Use the continuous and finite coefficient presentations [def-sfb-integral-comparison-coefficients] and their finite-projection normalization [def-sfb-integral-comparison-normalization]. Define $e$ to be the uniquely normalized abelian comparison $B\simeq\widehat B$. The section-ring isomorphism $\alpha:B_{\rm sec}\simeq\widehat B$ is the unique commutative-ring lift whose underlying abelian map is $e$, after the fixed identifications of the underlying abelian sheaves. Using the section-action equivalence $S$ of [def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence] and restriction of scalars [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars], define $F=\operatorname{Res}_{\alpha^{-1}}\circ S$ (first section action, then restriction along $\alpha^{-1}$). Its additive equivalence structure is the sectionwise one. Define $D(F):D(\operatorname{Mod}_{\rm int}(B))\simeq D(\operatorname{Mod}(\widehat B))$ by termwise localization of this actual functor [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]; its target is the derived category of the completed-coefficient module category [def-sf-scalar-reduction-categories-restriction]. These are the fixed comparison constructions, not a supplied arbitrary encoding or a constructibility/completeness assertion.
